invariants: no stage begins before the fence reads true
every stage emits a checkpoint before the next stage reads it
T0 must reproduce the frozen baseline or the run stops
no evaluation set used for selection is ever used for reporting

stages.entry_gate: stage T0 may not start until stage none is sealed
stages.intent: Reproduce the frozen substrate's measured baseline before changing anything. A training run that cannot reproduce its own starting point cannot attribute a delta.
stages.name: baseline_reproduction

stages.entry_gate: stage T1 may not start until stage T0 is sealed
stages.intent: Continued training under the selected capability profile.
stages.name: capability_conditioned_continued_training

stages.entry_gate: stage T2 may not start until stage T1 is sealed
stages.intent: Quantization-aware headroom recovery at the frozen rate.
stages.name: qat_headroom

stages.entry_gate: stage T3 may not start until stage T2 is sealed
stages.intent: Reduce long-horizon divergence from the parent's reasoning trajectory.
stages.name: trajectory_stabilization

stages.entry_gate: stage T4 may not start until stage T3 is sealed
stages.intent: Restore full authorized expression of the preserved capability inside the profile.
stages.name: forge_profile_expression

stages.entry_gate: stage T5 may not start until stage T4 is sealed
stages.intent: Hidden-set replication plus the sovereignty gauntlet. Nothing graduates on a seen set.
stages.name: hidden_replication_and_sovereignty
